title: Fill the heart until fear finds no place
summary: When the Lord fills the heart, the world loses its power to touch the center. Fill the heart before you start measuring what can hurt you.
takeaway: Fill the heart before the world gets to define the threat.
lifeApplication: Before calculating the worst outcome, repeat the line that places the Lord in the heart and let the calculation lose its throne.

source.shortMeaning: The one whose heart is filled with the Lord is no longer reached by the world in the same way.
source.lifeApplication: When fear starts mapping outcomes, fill the heart before calculating again.

evidence.coreClaim: Fear loses authority when the Lord, not the world, occupies the heart’s center.
evidence.turn: Let hope in the Lord outrank the world's reach.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before calculating the worst outcome, repeat the line that places the Lord in the heart and let the calculation lose its throne.
